chapter: Union, Emmett Hardy and Rampart Street Parade
title: Writing Rampart Street Parade from three standard tunes
summary: He explains how he patterned the number on High Society, Panama and Fidgety Feet to evoke a New Orleans jazz and parade band.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
